sloka: उद्घुष्टं वानराणां च राक्षसानां च निस्वनः।दिशो दश समुद्रं च पृथिवीं चान्वनादयत् ।। ६.७५.३२ ।।
transliteration: udghuṣṭaṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca rākṣasānāṁ ca nisvanaḥ।diśo daśa samudraṁ ca pṛthivīṁ cānvanādayat ।। 6.75.32 ।।

translations.english: By the smoke that spread, scorched by the fire, the clamour of the women folk at the top of their voice was heard at a hundred yojanas.
